blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines—Iran finally got on the 2026 Asian Games medal board after beating China, 79-70, in the men’s basketball bronze-medal game at Aichi International Arena in Japan on Sunday. Matin Aghajanpour led the Iranians’ effort with a team-high 21 points, giving the country its first medal in the continental games. Iran defeated Bahrain in the quarterfinals before falling to South Korea in the semifinals. Peter Girgoorian and Jafari Mahdi added 15 and 10 points, respectively, while Mobin Sheikhi, who gave Gilas Pilipinas problems in the 2027 Fiba World Cup […]...
